name: learnbot-mcp
description: AI chatbot orchestrator — persona management, conversation lifecycle, safety guardrails, multi-platform output, language learning

tools.persona_create: Create or update a chatbot persona
tools.chat_start: Start a new conversation with a persona
tools.chat_send: Send a message in an active conversation
tools.chat_destroy: Delete a conversation and all turns
tools.chat_proactive_tick: Check all personas for due proactive triggers
tools.platform_send: Send content to a platform bridge
tools.vocab_submit: Submit quiz result, schedule next review
tools.grammar_check: LLM-based sentence correction with JLPT level
tools.reading_passage: Generate graded reading passage with questions
tools.graded_reader: Structured graded reader with vocab + comprehension + discussion
tools.lesson_generate: AI generates full lesson from a title
tools.lesson_run: Inject lesson into conversation as active curriculum
tools.lesson_differentiate: Adapt lesson for different JLPT level
tools.vocab_lookup: Dictionary search or JLPT-graded vocab list
tools.example_sentences: Example sentences for a Japanese word
